title: cyanea obtusa
intro: Cyanea obtusa, commonly known as the Hawaiian Hedyotis or Hedyotis obtusa, is a rare and endangered plant species native to the Hawaiian Islands. It has been used in traditional Hawaiian medicine for various purposes, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyanea obtusa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal properties and potential health benefits of this plant.
